subject: Operations
title: Trade Agreements
description: Learn Trade Agreements in one minute.

hook.text: NAFTA turned North America into one of the world's largest free trade zones. Factories relocated within months.

buildup.text: Trade agreements reduce tariffs and harmonize regulations between member countries, enabling freer movement of goods.

discovery.text: They create rules of origin that determine which goods qualify for preferential treatment based on where value is added.

twist.text: Trade agreements have winners and losers. Workers in industries facing new competition often bear the adjustment cost.

climax.text: USMCA replaced NAFTA with updated rules on digital trade, labor standards, and automotive content requirements.

punchline.text: Trade deals open borders for goods. Companies must adapt or lose.

quiz.question: What do trade agreements typically reduce?
